description: This file defines x86_64 (Intel 64) specific system call interface functions, including inline assembly routines for invoking system calls with varying argument counts, and a function to check user context. It is part of the Zephyr RTOS architecture-specific code for x86.

methods.name: arch_syscall_invoke6
methods.description: Performs a system call with six arguments using inline assembly and the syscall instruction.

methods.name: arch_syscall_invoke5
methods.description: Performs a system call with five arguments.

methods.name: arch_syscall_invoke4
methods.description: Performs a system call with four arguments.

methods.name: arch_syscall_invoke3
methods.description: Performs a system call with three arguments.

methods.name: arch_syscall_invoke2
methods.description: Performs a system call with two arguments.

methods.name: arch_syscall_invoke1
methods.description: Performs a system call with one argument.

methods.name: arch_syscall_invoke0
methods.description: Performs a system call with no arguments.

methods.name: arch_is_user_context
methods.description: Checks if the current execution context is user mode by inspecting the CS register.
